How do I use it properly the very first time?
To play Savannah Park for the first time, set up each player's park board with their set of animal tiles.
During the game, players take turns calling out a specific tile to move. Everyone then picks that tile from their board and moves it to a new empty space to build larger herds near watering holes and protect animals from brush fires.
Once all tiles have been moved, you score points based on your herds and watering holes!
